newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SECURITIES COM TURNS DOWN HANSA INVESTMENTS.
newsitem.headline: SECURITIES COM TURNS DOWN HANSA INVESTMENTS.

text.p: Lithuania's securities commission said on Friday that it had rejected an application by Hansa Investments to carry out investment management and consulting activities in the country.
"The license for Hansa Investments was not issued today," Virgilijus Poderys, the head of the securities commission, told Reuters.
He added that the decision was based on minor legal grounds and that Hansa Investments, a subsidiary of Estonia's Hansapank, was welcome to apply again.
"It was not a principled rejection, but at the moment Hansa Investment's by-laws do not comply with the requirements of Lithuania's law on public trading and securities," Poderys said.
Hansa Investment was the first foreign investment management and consulting firm to apply to the Lithuanian securities commission, he said.
